steps.title: Redesign Layout to RelativeLayout Root
steps.description: Convert activity_main.xml to use RelativeLayout as root for view layering.

steps.title: Expand Camera SurfaceView
steps.description: Set SurfaceView to fill full screen (match_parent width & height) for immersive scanning.

steps.title: Style Translucent Header Overlaid
steps.description: Establish a stylish, translucent top bar containing the app title directly over the camera preview.

steps.title: Create Translucent Bottom Controls Overlaid Panel
steps.description: Add a ScrollView with a translucent dark overlay container at the bottom to house text boxes and sliders.

steps.title: Reposition Laser Scanner Line
steps.description: Ensure the animated scanning laser line runs across the full height of the viewport.

steps.title: Align View IDs and Bindings
steps.description: Keep standard UI IDs for Buttons, EditText, SeekBars and TextViews to prevent crash in MainActivity.

steps.title: Optimize Camera Focus
steps.description: Verify continuous portrait picture autofocus is supported and configured cleanly on camera initialization.

steps.title: Check Runtime OCR Simulation Rules
steps.description: Maintain dynamic brightness and contrast calculations based on camera frame pixel matrix analysis.

steps.title: Configure App Build Dependencies
steps.description: Clean up unused NanoHTTPD libraries from app build.gradle to ensure lightning-fast compile times.

steps.title: Verify Target SDK Compatibility
steps.description: Assure compile and target SDK versions are matched with 34 in compliance with standard actions.

steps.title: Building Scan Speak
steps.description: Assemble and build the final executable Scan Speak app with full screen camera view and overlays.
